items.text:
Update: I've played a bit more since my initial review and while I think I overreacted previously, the gameplay loop quickly gets stale.

This game is barely functional and has no interest in telling you how its mechanics work or giving you a reason to want to learn how they work. Constant beeping from 20 different consoles that means nothing also really gets on my nerves after awhile.
items.text_zh:
更新：自初次评测以来我又玩了一些，虽然我觉得之前反应过度了，但玩法循环很快就变得乏味。

这款游戏勉强能运行，而且完全不想告诉你它的机制如何运作，也不给你一个想去了解它们如何运作的理由。来自20个不同控制台的持续哔哔声毫无意义，过一阵子也真的让我很烦躁。

observations.description: 多个控制台持续发出无意义蜂鸣声
observations.evidence: Constant beeping from 20 different consoles that means nothing also really gets on my nerves after awhile
